* This site is 'adjacent' to the site where the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] vehicle is (for example, [[Expand The Empire]] can expand text to or from here).
* This site is 'related' to all sites on the same planet that the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] is on.
* This site does ''not'' take on the name of the planet (e.g. it is not a [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] site, a character here is not 'on [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]]' or 'on Cloud City' even if the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] is, etc).
